blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: General-purpose mobile manipulation requires a combination of capable robot hardware, scalable demonstration collection, expressive whole-body control, and effective policy learning. Yet these components are often developed independently, creating mismatches that limit the capabilities of the complete system. We present Pixel, a co-designed full-stack system for learning general-purpose mobile manipulation. Pixel combines a low-cost wheeled humanoid with human-aligned kinematics and compliant grippers, multiple teleoperation and robot-free human data-collection interfaces, a unified whole-body controller, and a common policy learning pipeline across human and robot demonstrations. A hierarchical learning stack further enables language-conditioned visuomotor control and long-horizon task execution. We evaluate the system across hardware, data collection, and policy learning, and demonstrate mobile-manipulation behaviors requiring dexterity, active perception, navigation, and whole-body coordination. We hope that Pixel provides an integrated and extensible foundation for studying how robot hardware, data, control, and learning can be designed together for robot learning. More results at https://pixel-robot.com/pixel
blocks.zh: 通用移动操控需要结合有能力的机器人硬件,可伸缩的演示集合,可表现的全身控制,以及有效的政策学习. 然而这些组件往往是独立开发的,造成不匹配,限制了整个系统的能力. 我们介绍Pixel,一个共同设计的用于学习通用移动操纵的全存储系统. 像素结合了一种低成本的轮式人造人与人相通的动能和相通的抓取器,多种远程操作和无机器人的人类数据收集接口,统一的全身控制器,以及跨越人和机器人演示的共同政策学习管道. 一个分级的学习堆进一步使语言条件化的粘接电动机控制和长距离任务执行成为可能. 我们通过硬件、数据收集和政策学习来评估系统,并展示移动操纵行为,这些行为需要分解、主动感知、导航和全身协调。 我们希望Pixel为研究机器人硬件,数据,控制和学习如何能一起设计为机器人学习提供一个综合而可扩展的基础. 更多结果见https://pixel-robot.com/pixel

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Imagine asking a robot to tidy your bedroom. It might need to collect clothes from the floor, place objects into cabinets at different heights, or operate a vacuum. The robot might also need to understand your instructions, determine where objects belong, plan a sequence of behaviors, and adapt when you rearrange the furniture.
blocks.zh: 想象一下让机器人帮你收拾卧室 它可能需要从地板上收集衣服,将物体放置在不同高度的柜子里,或者操作真空. 机器人可能还需要理解你的指令,确定物体属于哪里, 计划一系列的行为, 以及重新整理家具时的适应。

blocks.en: Realizing this vision requires integration across a deep robot-learning stack. The hardware must provide the mobility, workspace, strength, compliance, and sensing needed to interact safely in human environments. Its morphology determines where it can reach and how effectively it can leverage different data sources, while its end effectors determine which objects and tools it can operate. Broad capability also requires large, diverse datasets and the interfaces that make such data practical to collect. Yet demonstrations are useful only if the robot’s controllers can translate them into safe, physically realizable motions and learning algorithms can extract behaviors that generalize to new situations. Maximizing system-level capability therefore requires co-design across these layers, such that no individual component becomes the bottleneck on the performance of the complete system.
blocks.zh: 要实现这一愿景,就需要在一个深层的机器人学习堆中实现一体化。 硬件必须提供人类环境中安全互动所需的机动性、工作空间、强度、合规性和感知。 它的形态决定它能到达哪里以及它能如何有效地利用不同的数据源,而它的终端效应器则决定它能操作哪些对象和工具. 广泛的能力还需要大型、多样化的数据集以及使这类数据能够实际收集的接口。 然而,只有当机器人控制器能够将其转化为安全、可实际实现的动作,并且学习算法能够提取到一般到新情况的行为时,演示才有用。 因此,实现系统一级能力的最大化需要在这些层次上共同设计,这样,任何单个组件都不可能成为整个系统性能的瓶颈。

blocks.en: Thus far, most robotics work focuses on individual parts of this stack. Open-source hardware platforms have made capable robots and end effectors increasingly accessible, but commonly leave scalable data collection, policy training, and deployment to downstream integration [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . Conversely, sensorized human interfaces enable demonstrations to be collected at scale without a physical robot, but transfer to a target platform remains constrained by its morphology, sensing, end effectors, and controllers [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Other systems connect hardware, teleoperation, and policy training to achieve impressive learned manipulation [ 7 , 8 ] , but use comparatively simple embodiments and rely primarily on demonstrations collected through teleoperation. What remains underexplored is a mobile manipulation system in which the embodiment, data interface, controller, action representation, and learning stack are designed jointly from the start.
blocks.zh: 到目前为止,大多数机器人的工作都集中在这堆的单个部分. 开源硬件平台使得有能力的机器人和终端效应器越来越方便使用,但通常会留下可扩展的数据收集,政策培训,以及部署到下游集成[1,2,3]. 反之,感官化的人类界面能够在没有物理机器人的情况下大规模采集演示,但转移到目标平台仍然受到其形态,感知,终端效应器,以及控制器[4,5,6]的限制. 其他系统将硬件、远程操作和政策培训联系起来,以实现令人印象深刻的学习操作[7、8],但使用相对简单的化身,主要依靠通过远程操作收集的演示。 仍然未充分探讨的是移动操作系统,其中的浮雕,数据接口,控制器,动作表示,和学习堆栈从一开始就共同设计.

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Hardware co-design. Our robot hardware and sensorized human data collection system are co-designed at all levels, with shared camera perspectives, aligned human–robot kinematics, paired end effectors designed from the ground up, and a functionally aligned lower-body design.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:硬件共设计. 我们的机器人硬件和感官化的人类数据收集系统是在各个级别共同设计的,有共享的相机视角,对齐的人类机器人动能,从地面上设计对齐的终端效应器,以及功能对齐的下体设计.

blocks.en: In this work, we present Pixel , a co-designed, open-source mobile robot and learning stack that enables broadly capable mobile manipulation. At the center of the system is a wheeled humanoid robot costing under $15,000. Its human-proportioned 17-DoF upper body is designed to align with human motion, while a holonomic mobile base, vertical lift, and articulating torso provide wide workspace coverage. Wide-aperture, high-force robot grippers are paired with lightweight, comfortable sensorized human-worn grippers, allowing demonstrations to be collected in the wild while retaining high action fidelity.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了像素,一个共同设计,开源的移动机器人和学习堆栈,可以进行广泛的移动操纵. 系统中心是一个轮式人造机器人,耗资不足15 000美元。 其人类比例的17-DoF上体设计与人类运动一致,而一个同位素移动基,垂直升力,以及清晰的躯干则提供了广泛的工作空间覆盖. 宽孔,高强度的机器人抓手与轻量级,舒适感知的人类-worn抓手对齐,可以同时在野外采集演示,同时保留高动作忠心.

blocks.en: This co-design extends from the hardware to the data-collection interfaces, control, and learning. Leader-arm teleoperation, VR teleoperation, and sensorized human demonstrations all produce task-space targets that are mapped to the robot through a shared whole-body controller that coordinates motion while accounting for joint limits and self-collision avoidance. We also introduce a common relative-base action space which represents motion consistently across human and robot demonstrations, enabling flexible policy training across data sources.
blocks.zh: 这种共同设计从硬件延伸到数据收集接口,控制和学习. 领导-武装远程操作、VR远程操作和感知人类演示都产生任务空间目标,通过一个共享的全体控制器来映射给机器人,该控制器协调运动,同时考虑联合限制和避免自我碰撞。 我们还引入了一个共同的相对行动空间,它代表着贯穿人类和机器人演示的一致运动,从而能够跨数据来源进行灵活的政策培训。

blocks.en: We systematically ablate design choices across hardware, data-collection interfaces, and model training. Policies trained from sensorized human demonstrations achieve an average task progress of 82.0% across three challenging mobile-manipulation tasks, while policies trained from robot-teleoperated demonstrations achieve 78.7% across three additional tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们系统地在硬件、数据收集接口和模型培训方面放弃设计选择。 从感官化的人类示范中培训的政策在三项挑战性移动操纵任务中取得了82.0%的平均任务进展,而从机器人-远程操作示范中培训的政策在三项额外任务中实现了78.7%。

blocks.en: By co-designing the robot and learning stack, Pixel supports rapid iteration across embodiment, data, learning, and deployment within a single extensible platform.
blocks.zh: 通过共同设计机器人和学习堆栈,Pixel支持快速迭代跨越浮雕,数据,学习,并在单一的可扩展平台内部署.

blocks.en: II RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Open-Source Robot Platforms
blocks.zh: II-A 开源机器人平台

blocks.en: Open-source robot platforms accelerate progress by lowering entry costs and enabling researchers to repair, extend, and iterate on others’ designs. Yet most prior work addresses only one layer of the robot-learning stack, whether hardware components such as end effectors [ 1 , 2 , 9 , 10 , 11 ] , demonstration interfaces for data collection [ 12 , 4 , 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 ] , or data and training infrastructure [ 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 ] . These projects broaden access, but building a complete system still requires integrating independently designed hardware, sensing, control, data collection, and learning infrastructure, often developed with different objectives and assumptions.
blocks.zh: 开放源码机器人平台通过降低进入成本,让研究人员能够修复、扩展和扩展他人的设计,加快进度。 然而,大多数先前的工作只涉及机器人学习堆栈的一层,无论是终端效应器等硬件组件[1,2,9,10,11],数据收集演示界面[12,4,13,14,15,16],还是数据和培训基础设施[17,18,19,20,21]. 这些项目拓宽了访问范围,但建立一个完整的系统仍然需要整合独立设计的硬件,感知,控制,数据收集,以及学习基础设施,这些技术往往以不同的目标和假设来开发.

blocks.en: Several platforms integrate multiple layers of the stack but retain important limitations. Some platforms offer more complete hardware systems but lack the morphology required for general-purpose mobile manipulation [ 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 ] . Other open platforms demonstrate impressive physical capabilities but either lack policy-training and deployment infrastructure [ 3 ] or emphasize locomotion over capable manipulation [ 26 , 27 ] . Systems that combine hardware, data collection, and policy training often rely heavily on teleoperation, limiting the scalability of data collection [ 7 , 8 , 28 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh: 一些平台整合了堆栈的多层,但保留了重要的限制. 一些平台提供更为完整的硬件系统,但缺乏通用移动操纵所需的形态[22,23,24,25]. 其他开放平台显示出令人印象深刻的实际能力,但要么缺乏政策培训和部署基础设施[3],要么强调对能操纵的机动性[26,27]。 结合硬件、数据收集和政策培训的系统往往严重依赖远程操作,限制了数据收集的可扩展性[7、8、28、29]。

blocks.en: Pixel aims to provide a complete, scalable system by co-designing all parts as one extensible stack.
blocks.zh: Pixel旨在通过将所有部件共同设计为可扩展堆栈来提供一个完整,可扩展的系统.

blocks.en: II-B UMI Systems & Human Data Collection
blocks.zh: II-B UMI 系统与人类数据收集

blocks.en: Human data-collection interfaces have grown rapidly in popularity because they enable data to be gathered easily and at scale without a robot. As a more scalable alternative to robot teleoperation, they have seen widespread adoption in both research and industry [ 30 , 31 ] .
blocks.zh: 人类数据收集接口的受欢迎程度迅速提高,因为这些接口能够使数据收集变得容易和规模化,没有机器人。 作为机器人远程操作的一种更可扩展的替代品,它们在研究和工业中都广泛采用[30,31].

blocks.en: Sensorized human data collection, however, introduces an embodiment gap: human actions must map to executable robot actions. Robot-compatible tools minimize this gap through a matching interface, ranging from early gripper-in-hand devices [ 32 , 33 , 34 ] to the UMI family [ 4 , 35 , 5 , 14 ] . Other methods trade direct alignment for more natural collection: DexUMI constrains the hand with an exoskeleton [ 36 ] ; DexCap and DexWild use wearable gloves with retargeting [ 37 , 6 ] ; and EgoMimic captures bare-hand egocentric video [ 38 ] . These designs balance natural interaction against action fidelity.
blocks.zh: 然而,敏锐的人类数据收集带来了一个体现空白:人类行动必须映射到可执行的机器人行动. 与机器人兼容的工具通过匹配的界面将这一缺口最小化,从早期的握手设备[32,33,34]到UMI家族[4,35,5,14]. 其他方法为更多自然采集进行直接对接: DexUMI用Exoskeleton [36] 限制手;DexCap和DexWild使用可穿戴的手套重新瞄准[37,6];以及EgoMimic拍摄裸手自负的视频[38]. 这些设计平衡了自然互动与行动忠诚。

blocks.en: While most prior systems capture primarily hand motion and target tabletop manipulation, recent work has begun using human demonstrations to learn richer behaviors involving active perception, whole-body coordination, and mobile manipulation. ActiveUMI and EgoMI jointly capture head and hand motion to enable learning of active-perception behaviors [ 5 , 39 ] . For mobile manipulation, EMMA co-trains on egocentric full-body human demonstrations and static robot data, while HoMMI learns bimanual navigation and manipulation from head-and-gripper UMI trajectories [ 40 , 41 ] . HuMI and HALOMI further extend human data collection to commercial humanoids by incorporating lower-body motion [ 42 , 43 ] . However, the co-design of these systems is generally localized to selected components or implemented on an existing robot embodiment.
blocks.zh: 虽然大多数之前的系统主要捕捉手动和靶台操纵,但最近的工作已经开始利用人类的演示来学习更丰富的行为,涉及主动感知,全身协调,移动操纵. ActiveUMI和EgoMI联合捕获头部和手动,以便学习主动感知行为[5,39]. 对于移动操控,EMMA在以自我为中心的全体人体演示和静态机器人数据上进行协同操控,而HOMMI则从头和头的UMI轨迹学双人导航和操控[40,41]. HuMI和HALOMI通过将下体运动[42,43]结合,将人类数据收集范围进一步扩大到商业人类类. 然而,这些系统的共同设计一般是局部化的选定部件,或者在现有的机器人化装置上实施.

blocks.en: Pixel jointly optimizes the complete system for seamless transfer from human demonstrations to whole-body robot skills.
blocks.zh: 像素联合优化了完整的系统,从人类演示到全身机器人技能的无缝转移.

blocks.en: II-C Behavior Cloning for Mobile Manipulation
blocks.zh: II-C 移动操纵的克隆行为

blocks.en: Behavior cloning has become a widely used approach to robot policy learning, driven in part by advances in policy architectures and action representations. ACT introduced action chunking to improve temporal modeling [ 7 ] ; Diffusion Policy brought diffusion models to robotics, enabling policies to represent multimodal action distributions [ 44 ] ; and UMI introduced relative end-effector actions to improve learning when no consistent absolute reference frame is available [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 行为克隆已成为机器人政策学习的一种广泛使用的方法,其部分动力是政策架构和行动表述方面的进步. 青蒿素综合疗法引入了行动块,以改善时间模型[7];传播 政策为机器人带来了推广模式,使政策能够代表多式联运分布[44];在缺乏一致的绝对参考框架时,UMI引入了相对的最终效果行动,以改善学习[4]。

blocks.en: Compared with tabletop manipulation, mobile manipulation can introduce additional challenges for behavior cloning, including tighter coupling between perception and action, compounding errors over longer horizons, and the difficulty of deploying learned policies on complex robotic systems. In the simplest setting, when demonstrations directly contain robot actions, policies can learn coordinated whole-body motion end to end [ 8 , 22 , 45 ] . However, this approach requires collecting demonstrations on the complete robot and assumes that teleoperating the robot through the desired motions is feasible, which can itself be challenging.
blocks.zh: 与桌面操控相比,移动操控会给行为克隆带来更多挑战,包括更紧密的感知与动作的结合,在更长的视野上使错误复杂化,以及在复杂的机器人系统上运用所学政策的困难. 在最简单的设定中,当演示直接包含机器人动作时,政策可以学习协调的全体运动结束到结束[8,22,45]. 然而,这种方法需要收集完整的机器人的演示材料,并假定通过期望的运动将机器人远程操作是可行的,而这本身可能具有挑战性。

blocks.en: Direct imitation of robot actions, however, is not always feasible. On legged robots, small joint-prediction errors can violate balance or contact constraints, while human demonstrations do not provide robot joint states. Many systems therefore predict task-space motion and delegate joint coordination to retargeting or whole-body control. Legged platforms pass learned end-effector trajectories to controllers that maintain balance [ 46 , 47 ] , while wheeled and humanoid systems map keyposes or human head, hand, pelvis, and foot motion to feasible whole-body actions [ 48 , 40 , 41 , 42 , 43 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,直接模仿机器人行动并不总是可行的。 在腿部机器人上,小的联动预测错误可以违反平衡或接触限制,而人类的演示则不能提供机器人联动状态. 因此,许多系统预测任务空间运动,并授权联合协调以重新确定目标或进行全身控制。 腿动平台将学到的末端效应轨迹传递给保持平衡[46,47]的控制器,而轮动和人文系统则将键盘或人头,手,骨盆,脚动都映射到可行的全身动作[48,40,41,42,43].

blocks.en: Long-horizon tasks may also require structure beyond low-level action prediction. Hi Robot decomposes instructions into atomic language commands executed by a low-level policy [ 49 ] ; CoT-VLA predicts visual subgoals before generating action chunks [ 50 ] ; and π 0.7 \pi_{0.7} uses language, strategy metadata, and visual subgoals to steer and compose behaviors across tasks [ 51 ] .
blocks.zh: 长视距任务也可能要求结构超越低级动作预测. Hi Robot将指令分解为由低级策略执行的原子语言指令[49]; CoT-VLA在生成动作块前预测视觉子目标[50];和 QQ 0.7\pi 0.7}使用语言,策略元数据,和视觉子目标来引导和编译跨任务的行为[51].

In general, our design is guided by three principles: G1. Cost-effective, reproducible, and safe. The system should maximize manipulation capability while minimizing hardware cost and complexity, remain easy to reproduce, maintain, and extend, and be safe to operate in human environments. G2. Scalable and high-fidelity data collection. The robot and data-collection interfaces should support scalable, high-fidelity data collection and facilitate learning from multiple data sources, including teleoperated and human demonstrations. G3. Broad everyday mobile-manipulation capability. The robot embodiment and learning stack should support a broad
range of everyday mobile manipulation behaviors, including dexterous, long-horizon, and whole-body
tasks.
blocks.zh:
一般而言,我们的设计遵循三项原则: G1. 成本效益高、可复制和安全。 该系统应最大限度地发挥操纵能力,同时尽量减少硬件成本和复杂性,保持易复制、维护和扩展,并在人类环境中安全运行。 G2. 可扩展和高可靠性数据收集。 机器人和数据收集接口应支持可扩展的高可靠性数据收集,并促进从多种数据来源学习,包括远程操作和人类演示。 G3. 广泛的日常移动操纵能力。 机器人的化身和学习堆应该支持广泛的

blocks.en: III-A Robot Hardware System
blocks.zh: 机器人硬件系统

blocks.en:
We design Pixel to support a wide range of everyday mobile-manipulation tasks in the open world, while making deliberate tradeoffs to balance our design goals G1 – G3 . At the architectural level, we choose to retain the task-relevant advantages of a humanoid morphology while minimizing the mechanical and control complexity of a full humanoid robot. A human-aligned upper body provides a human-like bimanual workspace for interacting with objects, tools, and environments designed for people, while also facilitating the transfer of human demonstrations in support of G2 . At the same time, a humanoid system with bipedal locomotion and multi-fingered hands would introduce substantial cost, control complexity, and maintenance concerns. Consistent with G1 , we therefore replace legs with a holonomic mobile base and passively stable vertical lift, and use simple custom grippers in place of dexterous hands. These choices trade some terrain versatility, lower-body articulation, and in-hand dexterity for simplicity, while preserving most of the mobility, vertical reach, and grasping capability needed to support the diverse whole-body and dexterous behaviors targeted by G3 . The complete hardware platform, shown in Figure 3 ,
can be assembled for under $15,000.

blocks.en: Holonomic Mobile Base. Pixel is built on a custom holonomic mobile base. Our base has a footprint of 45.5 ​ cm × 53.5 ​ cm 45.5\,\mathrm{cm}\times 53.5\,\mathrm{cm} , compared with 50.0 ​ cm × 54.0 ​ cm 50.0\,\mathrm{cm}\times 54.0\,\mathrm{cm} for TidyBot++ [ 22 ] . This compact footprint allows the robot to navigate cluttered indoor environments and pass through standard doorways. Holonomic mobility enables independent planar translation and rotation, improving maneuverability in confined indoor environments [ 22 ] , providing a simple action space for whole-body teleoperation and policy learning, and facilitating the transfer of natural human whole-body motion to the robot in support of G2 .

blocks.en: Unlike the offset powered-caster design used by TidyBot++, we use zero-offset swerve modules, whose steering axes approximately intersect the wheel contact patches, thus decoupling the steering from chassis motion. This decoupling of steering and chassis translation is particularly important for mobile manipulation, where small steering inputs to the base can cause jerky motions in the end-effector pose and compromise more precise tasks. The resulting drivetrain does not require additional CNC-machined parts [ 22 ] and provides simpler kinematic control. Base control details are available in Appendix -A .

blocks.en: Torso, Head, and Arms. To facilitate the transfer of human demonstrations to robot motion, Pixel uses a human-proportioned, 17-DoF upper body comprising a torso-pitch joint, two 7-DoF arms, and a 2-DoF head. Compared with mobile manipulators whose arms and cameras are rigidly mounted to the lift structure [ 3 , 8 , 53 ] , these additional degrees of freedom allow the robot to easily reposition both its manipulation workspace and sensing orientation. In particular, torso articulation extends the forward and downward reach of both arms, while the actuated head enables the robot to maintain task-relevant regions within view during manipulation. These degrees of freedom expand the robot’s whole-body manipulation capability ( G3 ) while allowing it to reproduce torso pitching and gaze behaviors present in human demonstrations ( G2 ).
blocks.zh: 托尔索,头,和武器。 为了方便人类向机器人运动转移演示,Pixel使用一个人造,17-DOF的上身,包括一个躯干-pitch关节,两个7-DOF手臂,以及一个2-DOF头. 与臂部和相机刚性安装到升降结构[3,8,53]的移动操纵器相比,这些额外的自由度使得机器人可以轻松地重新定位其操纵工作空间和感知方向. 特别是,躯干伸展扩大了两臂的向前和向下伸展,而起动头则使机器人能够在操纵时保持视线内与任务有关的区域。 这些自由度扩展了机器人的全身操控能力(G3),同时允许机器人复制躯干投球和凝视人类演示(G2)中存在的行为.

blocks.en: To avoid unnecessary mechanical and manufacturing complexity, the upper body is built around a simple, rigid torso structure consistent with G1 . The torso is assembled from waterjet-cut, 6.35 ​ mm 6.35\,\mathrm{mm} -thick 6061-T6 aluminum plates and is cantilevered from a single torso-pitch joint driven by a MyActuator X10-100 actuator with a rated torque of 50 ​ N ​ m 50\,\mathrm{N\,m} . Coordinating this joint with the vertical lift and arms allows the robot to reach low or recessed objects while maintaining a stable base configuration. To reduce the kinematic mismatch between human and robot motion ( G2 ), we use two AgileX NERO arms, each with 7 DoFs, a rated payload of 3 ​ kg 3\,\mathrm{kg} , and human-like kinematics. The redundant arm degree of freedom provides additional flexibility for satisfying end-effector targets while avoiding joint limits, self-collisions, and unfavorable configurations in confined bimanual workspaces. The head is actuated in yaw and pitch by two DAMIAO DM-J4310-2EC actuators, allowing the onboard cameras to be oriented independently of the torso.
blocks.zh: 为了避免不必要的机械和制造复杂性,上部车体是围绕一个与G1一致的简单,刚性躯干结构建造的. 躯干由喷水机组装, 6.35毫米 6.35\,\mathrm{mm} -thick 6061-T6铝板,由MyActuator X10-100驱动的单躯干-pitch联轴器罐装,额定扭矩为50 N m 50\,\mathrm{N\,m}。 与垂直升降机和手臂协调这个关节使机器人能够到达低空或沉降的物体,同时保持稳定的基座配置. 为了减少人类和机器人运动(G2)之间的运动不匹配,我们使用了两个AgileX NERO武器,每个武器有7个DOF,额定有效载荷为3kg 3\,\mathrm{kg}和类似人类的运动器. 多余的自由臂级为满足最终效果目标提供了额外的灵活性,同时避免了在封闭的双人工作空间中的联合限制,自我碰撞和不合适的配置. 头部在yaw中被两个DAMIAO DM-J4310-2EC激活,使机上摄像头能够独立于躯干进行定向.

blocks.en: End Effector. Everyday manipulation requires both precise handling of small objects and secure grasping of large or heavy objects. Although multi-fingered hands provide additional dexterity, they introduce considerable mechanical and control complexity. At the same time, the end effector should enable intuitive and scalable data collection. We therefore co-design a simple, single-DoF pincer gripper and a corresponding human-worn demonstration interface, balancing the simplicity and reproducibility of G1 with the high-fidelity data collection required by G2 . The gripper follows a finger-aligned design resembling the natural pinch motion of the thumb and index finger, making it intuitive for human demonstration while remaining capable of grasping a diverse range of objects during robot deployment [ 14 ] . The human-worn interface preserves the task-facing finger geometry and wrist-camera placement of the robot gripper, reducing observation and action mismatch between demonstration and deployment [ 4 ] . We describe the wearable interface in further detail in Section III-B .
blocks.zh: 终结者 日常操纵既需要精确处理小物体,也需要牢牢抓住大型或重型物体. 虽然多指手可提供额外的弹性,但它们引入了相当的机械和控制复杂性. 同时,终端效应器应能够进行直观和可扩展的数据收集。 因此,我们共同设计了一个简单的,单一的DoF pincer 抓取器和相应的人文化演示界面,平衡了G1的简单和可复制性与G2所要求的高可靠性数据收集. 握手者遵循一个指向式设计,类似拇指和食指的自然捏动,使其直观地用于人类的演示,同时在机器人部署期间仍然能够抓住各种各样的物体[14]. 人-劳接口保留了机器人抓手的任务指几何和手腕相机的布置,减少了演示和部署之间的观察和动作不匹配[4]. 我们将在第三节B进一步详细描述可穿戴界面。

blocks.en: On the robot side, each gripper is driven by a DAMIAO DM-J4310-2EC actuator through a 14-tooth pinion and two 36-tooth finger gears, yielding a 2.57 : 1 2.57{:}1 reduction. At a motor torque of 3 ​ N ​ m 3\,\mathrm{N\,m} , the transmission provides a nominal combined torque of 7.71 ​ N ​ m 7.71\,\mathrm{N\,m} across the finger pivots and a measured closing force exceeding 90 ​ N 90\,\mathrm{N} . The pincer mechanism provides a maximum aperture of 240 ​ mm 240\,\mathrm{mm} while maintaining a compact and mechanically simple construction.

blocks.en:
Each finger consists of a rigid 3D-printed PETG structure, a compliant 95A-TPU membrane, and a Shore-A 30 Dragon Skin silicone contact surface. The distal portion is narrow and comparatively rigid, enabling precise grasps of small and thin objects. The wider, compliant proximal region conforms to larger objects and handles, increasing contact area and resistance to slip. Separating the rigid load-bearing structure from the compliant membrane allows the finger geometry and surface compliance to be tuned independently. Because deformation of the compliant membrane is visible in the wrist-camera
image, it also provides visual cues about contact state and grasp force without requiring dedicated tactile sensors, providing additional information to the policy in support of G3 .

图像,它也提供了视觉提示 接触状态和抓住力 不要求专用触觉传感器, 提供更多信息 支持G3的政策。

blocks.en: The policy commands the gripper using continuous aperture targets, which are tracked using an impedance controller with variable stiffness, damping, and torque limits. Lower gains provide compliant contact for delicate objects, while higher gains enable secure power grasps. Each robot-mounted gripper weighs 680 ​ g 680\,\mathrm{g} and can be assembled for under $200.

blocks.en:
Sensing, Compute, and Electrical Architecture. Mobile manipulation in the open world requires tightly integrated sensing, computation, communication, and power delivery. Pixel therefore uses a fully onboard architecture designed to support real-time control and perception ( G3 ) while remaining modular, low-cost, and easy to maintain
( G1 ).

blocks.en: The robot’s sensing suite consists of three Arducam B0385 global-shutter RGB cameras (one on each wrist and one on the head), a head-mounted Intel RealSense D435 RGB-D camera, and a base-mounted Livox Mid-360 LiDAR. The RGB cameras stream camera-native MJPEG at 640 × 480 640\times 480 and 100 FPS, with a wide field of view of approximately 160 ∘ 160^{\circ} diagonally. Global shutters reduce motion artifacts, and the onboard JPEG compression lowers the processing and storage overhead of multi-view data collection. The wrist cameras capture close-range contact information, and the head camera supplies broader scene context. The D435 provides aligned RGB and depth, which enables 3D reconstruction of the scene and the training of policies based on depth images or point clouds. The LiDAR and its integrated IMU can be used for SLAM or navigation ( G3 ).

blocks.en: Computation is divided between a Raspberry Pi 4 and an onboard GPU laptop. The Raspberry Pi controls the drivetrain and lift, whereas the laptop handles whole-body control, data collection, and policy inference. The two computers communicate using ROS 2 over a private wired Ethernet network, with a Wi-Fi access point supporting wireless VR and leader-arm teleoperation. Motor communication is divided across four CAN networks: one for the drivetrain and lift, one for the torso and head, and one for each arm and gripper.
blocks.zh: 计算分为Raspberry Pi 4和机载GPU笔记本电脑. 红莓 Pi控制着驱动列车和升降机,而笔记本电脑则处理全身控制,数据收集以及政策推论. 两台计算机通过一个私人有线以太网网络使用ROS 2进行通信,其中Wi-Fi接入点支持无线VR和头头-臂远程操作. 汽车通信分为四个CAN网络:一个用于驱动列车和升降机,一个用于躯干和头部,一个用于每个手臂和抓手.

blocks.en: To accommodate devices with different power requirements, Pixel uses two complementary onboard power sources. A 48 ​ V 48\,\mathrm{V} , 25 ​ Ah 25\,\mathrm{Ah} lithium iron phosphate (LFP) battery supplies the robot’s DC electronics, while a 288 ​ Wh 288\,\mathrm{Wh} portable AC power source rated at 300 ​ W 300\,\mathrm{W} powers the GPU laptop, networking equipment, and other peripherals through their standard power adapters. This separation allows compute, sensing, and networking hardware to be added or replaced without redesigning the robot’s DC power distribution, supporting the extensibility objectives of G1 . LFP was chosen for its long cycle life and favorable thermal stability during frequent operation, making it a safe and reliable choice consistent with G1 . Together, the two sources provide approximately 2.5 2.5 – 3 3 hours of untethered operation, with runtime primarily limited by the smaller AC source and the GPU laptop’s power consumption.

LFP在频繁运行期间被选为周期长且热稳定性较好的选用,使其成为符合G1的安全和可靠的选择. 这两个来源共同提供约2.5 – 3小时的未调试操作,运行时间主要受较小的AC源和GPU笔记本电脑的功耗限制.

blocks.en: III-B Whole-Body Control and Data Collection Interfaces
blocks.zh: III-B 整体控制与数据收集接口

blocks.en: Everyday tasks such as retrieving objects from the floor, loading a dishwasher, and opening a drawer require coordinated motion of the whole body. Supporting these behaviors on a 23 23 -DoF platform presents challenges for both control and data collection. For many tasks, teleoperators must command the entire robot to produce coherent whole-body motions. Sensorized human demonstrations also need to be mapped effectively to robot motions without losing task-relevant behavior.
blocks.zh: 每天从地板上取回物品,装上洗碗机和打开抽屉等任务都需要整个身体的协调运动. 在23 23 - DoF平台上支持这些行为对控制和数据收集都构成挑战。 对于许多任务,远程操作者必须命令整个机器人产生连贯的全身运动. 感知到的人类演示也需要有效地映射到机器人运动,而不会失去与任务相关的行为.

blocks.en: Following our goal to facilitate learning from multiple sources in G2 , we co-design a unified whole-body controller used by both teleoperation and task-space target tracking, custom teleoperation hardware and interfaces, and a sensorized human data collection system. These components enable policies to efficiently learn coordinated and expressive whole-body behaviors on Pixel.
blocks.zh: 按照我们促进从G2多个来源学习的目标,我们共同设计了一个统一的全体控制器,既用于远程操作,也用于任务空间目标跟踪,定制远程操作硬件和接口,以及一个感官化的人类数据收集系统。 这些组件使得政策能够有效地学习比素上协调和表现的全身行为.

blocks.en: Whole-Body Controller. We use a shared whole-body controller to maintain consistent motion characteristics across demonstrations collected with different devices, thereby reducing the mismatch between data collection and learned policy execution.
blocks.zh: 整个Body控制器。 我们使用一个共享的全体控制器来保持用不同设备收集的演示的一致运动特性,从而减少数据收集与学到的政策执行之间的不匹配.

blocks.en: We use geometric fabrics [ 54 , 55 ] to generate coordinated whole-body motion from task-space targets. Fabrics pair each local acceleration policy with a metric that determines its relative influence and preferred directions of motion. A key benefit is their state-dependent metrics , which allow motion priorities to adapt to the robot configuration, velocity, and targets as reachability or proximity to joint limits changes. The robot’s kinematics map the local policies into a common configuration space, where they combine into a single acceleration field. COWBOY [ 56 ] implements fabrics-based whole-body control for a mobile robot with one manipulation arm and an actuated camera arm. We extend fabrics-based whole-body control to a wheeled humanoid with two manipulation arms, an articulated torso, a vertical lift, and an actuated head.
blocks.zh: 我们用几何织物[54,55]从任务空间目标产生协调的全身运动. Fabrics将每个局部加速政策配以一个度量,确定其相对影响和偏好的运动方向. 一个关键的好处是它们依赖于状态的衡量标准,它允许运动优先级适应机器人的配置,速度,以及作为可达到性或接近联合限制变化的目标. 机器人的动能将本地政策映射到一个共同的配置空间,它们结合到一个单一的加速场中. COWBOY [56] 执行基于织物的全身控制 移动机器人有一个操纵臂和一个动镜头臂. 我们把以织物为基础的全身控制扩展到一个轮式人造物上,它有两个操纵臂,一个清晰的躯干,一个垂直的升力,以及一个动头。

blocks.en: Hand and head pose tracking. Pose attractors draw the two grippers and the head toward desired positions and orientations, with damping near each target. These tasks act through the robot’s full-body kinematics, so tracking a hand or head pose can coordinate base motion, lift height, and torso posture. Head targets specify both viewpoint and viewing direction: VR teleoperation derives the orientation from a hand-based look-at point (Equation 1 ), while learned policies predict head poses directly. Gripper apertures are controlled separately.
blocks.zh: 手头姿势追踪 Pose吸引器将两个抓手和头部引向理想的位置和方向,在每个目标附近筑坝. 这些任务通过机器人的全身运动动作来进行,因此跟踪一个手或头姿可以协调基部运动,提升高度,以及躯干姿态. 主要目标指定了观点和取景方向: VR远程操作从一个手动的视点(方程式1)获得方向,而学习到的政策则直接预测头部. Gripper孔径单独控制.

blocks.en: Reach-dependent base coordination. A base-translation term favors arm motion when the hand targets are nearby and allows greater base participation as they move beyond reach. We approximate each arm’s workspace by a sphere centered at its shoulder. When all active hand targets lie within these estimated workspaces, a large metric makes base acceleration more costly, encouraging the arms to accommodate the motion. As either target moves beyond its workspace radius, the metric decreases smoothly, allowing the pose attractors to recruit more base translation. Damping moderates base motion throughout this transition. This term lets the controller move continuously between local manipulation and coordinated base–arm reaching without a separate base-position target.
blocks.zh: 依赖接触的基础协调。 一个基础翻译术语在手目标靠近时会有利于手臂运动,并允许在它们无法到达时有更多的基础参与. 我们用一个以臂部为中心, 当所有活跃的手目标都位于这些估计的工作空间内时,一个大的尺度使基数加速成本更高,鼓励武器容纳运动。 随着任一目标超越工作空间半径,衡量标准会顺利下降,使姿势吸引者能够征聘更多的基础翻译。 在整个过渡期间,大坝会调节基础运动。 这个术语允许控制器在局部操纵与协调的基-臂之间不断移动,在没有单独的基位目标的情况下到达.

blocks.en: Posture and motion allocation. Posture attractors favor a nominal body configuration while the hand and head targets are tracked. Leader-arm teleoperation can supply arm and torso posture references to preserve the operator’s intended configuration. A separate motion-allocation metric assigns greater cost to lift and torso acceleration, biasing motion toward the arms while retaining whole-body flexibility. For base rotation, a yaw attractor follows a heading derived from the hand targets and desired viewing direction; a heading-dependent metric reduces unnecessary rotation near this heading. Together, these terms express weighted preferences for how the robot uses its redundant degrees of freedom.
blocks.zh: 姿态和运动分配。 姿势吸引器倾向于在手和头目标被跟踪时进行名义上的身体配置. 长臂远程操作可以提供手臂和躯干姿态参考,以保持操作员的预定配置。 一个单独的运动分配指标为提升和躯干加速度分配了更大的成本,使运动偏重于手臂,同时保持全身的灵活性。 对于基旋转,一个yaw吸引器遵循从手目标以及所期望的取景方向产生的标题;一个依赖标题的度量法会减少此标题附近的不必要的旋转. 这些术语共同表达了机器人如何使用其多余的自由度的加权偏好.

blocks.en: Avoidance and motion generation. Joint-limit repulsion steers joints away from their boundaries, while repulsion between link-attached spheres discourages self-collision. These behaviors contribute soft motion preferences to the combined controller. The resulting acceleration field is damped, bounded, and integrated at 200 ​ Hz 200\,\mathrm{Hz} into joint-position and base-velocity references tracked by the low-level controllers. Appendix -C presents the mathematical formulation and controller parameters.
blocks.zh: 回避与运动生成. 联合限制反感使关节远离其边界,而连接-附着球体之间的反感则劝阻自我结合. 这些行为为组合控制器提供了软运动偏好. 由此产生的加速度场被坝,定界,并在200 Hz 200\,\mathrm{Hz}整合到由低级控制器跟踪的联位和基速引用中. 附录-C介绍数学配体和控制器参数.

blocks.en: Teleoperation Hardware and Interfaces
blocks.zh: 远程操作硬件和接口

blocks.en: To accommodate diverse users and tasks, we design two forms of teleoperation devices for the robot: a leader arm system for dexterous tabletop tasks and a VR teleoperation system for whole-body manipulation skills. Figure 4 presents our two teleoperation approaches.
blocks.zh: 为了适应不同的用户和任务,我们为机器人设计了两种形式的远程操作设备:一个用于 dexterous tabletop任务的领先臂系统,另一个用于全体操纵技能的VR远程操作系统. 图4介绍了我们的两种远程业务办法。

blocks.en: Leader Arm System. For many fine-grained tasks, a leader arm system can be intuitive as it provides the teleoperator with a physically grounded representation of the robot [ 12 ] . We design a kinematically matched, 65%-scale replica of the robot’s torso and two 7-DoF arms, with integrated triggers for continuous gripper control. We omit the robot’s actuated head from the replica and instead delegate gaze control to the whole-body controller, reducing the size and complexity of the interface without sacrificing gaze control.
blocks.zh: 头盔系统。 对于许多精细的配角任务来说,领臂系统可以直观,因为它为电动操作器提供了机器人的实实在在的代表[12]. 我们设计了一个动能匹配,65%的机器人躯干复制品和两只7-DoF臂,并配有连续控制抓手的综合触发器。 我们从复制品中省略了机器人的激活头部, 转而将目视控制权下放给全身控制器,

blocks.en: The leader arm station is constructed primarily from 3D-printed parts and off-the-shelf Dynamixel servos, making the interface straightforward to reproduce and maintain in support of G1 . The joints are actuated and support features such as gravity and friction compensation, virtual joint limits, configurable null-space posture regulation, and bilateral force feedback [ 15 , 16 ] . Gravity compensation reduces operator effort by counteracting the weight of the device, null-space regulation improves ergonomics by biasing each leader arm toward a comfortable configuration, and force feedback improves contact awareness by reflecting the robot’s interaction forces back to the operator. Buttons integrated into the handles raise and lower the lift, while thumb joysticks command planar base translation and rotation.
blocks.zh: 领臂站主要由3D打印的部件和现成的Dynamixel服务器建造,使接口可以直接复制和维护,以支持G1. 关节被激活,支持重力和摩擦补偿,虚拟联动极限,可配置的空位姿态调控,双边力反馈[15,16]等特征. 重力补偿通过抵消设备的重量来减少操作者的努力,无空间调控通过将每个领头臂偏重于舒适的配置来改善人机学,强制反馈通过将机器人的相互作用力反射给操作者来提高接触意识. 按钮集成到手柄中,升降升降机,而拇指乐杆则指挥着浮游艇基地的翻译和旋转.

blocks.en: A central design choice is that the measured leader-arm angles are not sent to the robot as joint-position targets. Instead, we use them in two complementary ways: we apply the leader configuration to the robot’s kinematic model to compute gripper poses that serve as primary task-space attractors, and we provide the joint angles as a secondary nominal posture objective. The task-space attractors allow the whole-body controller to coordinate the arms with the torso, lift, and base while accounting for joint limits and self-collision avoidance. Because the gripper poses do not fully specify the configuration of the robot’s redundant upper body, the nominal posture objective additionally biases the robot toward the operator’s intended torso and elbow configuration. These objectives preserve both the task-level motion and the configuration-level intent of the operator to enable more expressive teleoperation for whole-body behaviors ( G3 ). Hardware and controller details are provided in Appendix -D .
blocks.zh: 一个中央设计选择是,被测量的领臂角度不是作为联合定位目标发送给机器人的. 相反,我们用两种互补的方式: 将领头人配置应用到机器人的运动模型中, 来计算担任主要任务空间吸引器的抓手, 我们提供联合角度作为次要名义姿态目标。 任务空间吸引器允许全身控制器与躯干,升力,和基座协调臂部,同时考虑联动限制和自我碰撞避免. 因为抓手的姿势并没有完全指定机器人冗余上身的配置,所以名义姿态的目标又进一步偏向了操作员的预定躯干和肘部配置. 这些目标既保留了任务级运动,也保留了操作员的配置级意图,以使得整个身体行为(G3 )能够更加表达式的远程操作. 硬件和控制器的细节见附录-D。

blocks.en: VR Teleoperation System. An untethered interface that allows the operator to move freely can make many whole-body tasks easier and more intuitive to teleoperate than with leader-arm systems. For example, the operator may need to reposition themselves for a better view of the scene or walk alongside the robot as it navigates through the environment. A VR-based interface supports this mobility while allowing the operator to continuously control the robot.
blocks.zh: VR远程操作系统. 一个允许操作员自由移动的无纹接口,可以使许多全身任务比领头-臂系统更容易和更直观地进行远程操作. 例如,操作员可能需要重新定位,以便更好地查看场景,或者在机器人通过环境航行时与机器人并肩行走. 基于VR的接口支持这种移动,同时允许操作员持续控制机器人.

blocks.en: We use the Meta Quest 3/3S for its relatively low cost and self-contained 6-DoF tracking, making the system easier to reproduce and supporting G1 . The headset is worn around the operator’s neck to provide body reference tracking, while the handheld controllers provide hand poses, continuous gripper commands, and auxiliary controls. Because the system is intended for local rather than remote teleoperation, the operator observes the robot and workspace directly instead of receiving streamed robot-camera images through the headset. This preserves the wide field of vision of human eyes and avoids latency-sensitive visual feedback, which can cause dizziness and disorientation during immersive teleoperation [ 57 , 58 ] . A custom OpenXR application based on [ 59 ] built in Unity transmits the headset and controller poses and inputs over the robot’s private Wi-Fi network through a ROS-TCP bridge, and the robot-side interface updates the whole-body targets at 60 ​ Hz 60\,\mathrm{Hz} . Controller haptics confirm calibration and mode changes without requiring the operator to consult a display, allowing the user to focus on the task at hand.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Meta Quest 3/3S来进行相对较低的成本和自成一体的6-DoF跟踪,使系统更容易复制和支持G1. 耳机被戴在操作员的颈部上,以提供身体参考跟踪,而手持控制器则提供手姿,连续抓取命令,以及辅助控制. 由于该系统是针对本地而不是远程远程操作的,操作员直接观察机器人和工作空间,而不是通过耳机接收流动的机器人-相机图像. 这保留了人类眼界的广阔视野,避免了耐久性敏感的视觉反馈,在浸泡式电传操作中,这会导致眩晕和迷惑[57,58]. 基于 [59] 构建于 Unity 的自定义 OpenXR 应用程序通过 ROS- TCP 桥向机器人的私人 Wi-Fi 网络上传输耳机和控制器的姿态和输入, 机器人侧界面以 60 Hz 60\,\ mathrm{ 更新全身目标 赫兹。 Controller hoptics 确认校准和模式的改变而不需要操作员查询显示,允许用户专注于手头的任务.

blocks.en: We provide two complementary base-control modes for different scenarios and compare them in Section IV-C . VR Joystick maps the controller thumbsticks to base-frame planar velocities, giving the operator explicit control over base motion. VR Body Tracking , when engaged through a controller clutch, maps the translation and yaw of the human teleoperator onto the robot base. The robot can therefore follow the operator’s body motion while remaining coordinated with the hand and head targets, which can be useful for whole-body tasks such as sweeping and opening doors. Both modes use the same whole-body controller and task-space target representation as the leader-arm interface and autonomous policy deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们为不同情况提供两种互补的基础控制模式,并在第四节C部分加以比较。 VR Joystick将控制器的拇指杆映射到基帧的平面速度,使操作员对基部运动有明确的控制. VR身体跟踪,当通过控制器离合器进行接触时,将人类电传操作器的翻译和yaw映射到机器人基地. 因此机器人可以跟随操作员的身体运动,同时与手和头部目标保持协调,这对扫地和打开门等全身任务有用. 两种模式都使用相同的全体控制器和任务空间目标代表作为领导-臂接口和自主政策部署.

blocks.en: Sensorized Human Data Collection

blocks.en: To enable more scalable data collection than teleoperation, we co-design a wearable human data collection system that enables Pixel to learn whole-body skills directly from humans performing tasks, without the need for a robot. The complete system uses off-the-shelf sensors and primarily 3D-printed parts, costs under $1,000, and can operate untethered for approximately 2.5 2.5 – 3 3 hours, consistent with the cost and reproducibility objectives of G1 . Separately, we process the gripper-state signals using a Hampel filter [ 62 ] for outlier rejection followed by Savitzky–Golay smoothing [ 63 ] . blocks.en:
Mobile manipulation presents a particularly challenging policy-learning
problem because a single task may combine coarse whole-body motion, such as
navigation, with precise manipulation,
such as grasping, insertion, or alignment. These behaviors unfold over horizons
substantially longer than those of typical tabletop tasks, increasing the effect
of control error accumulation and making policies more likely to encounter observations that
are poorly represented in the demonstration data. Moreover, open-ended tasks
may require several distinct skills whose order depends on the user’s request
and the current state of the environment.

To realize broad everyday mobile-manipulation capability G3 , we design a

mobile-manipulation skills, while a vision-language model (VLM) decomposes
open-ended user requests into supported skills and monitors their execution.
This hierarchy allows the low-level policy to specialize in closed-loop
visuomotor control while the VLM handles skill composition, progress tracking,
and interaction with the user, resulting in a powerful and general policy learning pipeline. Our policy architecture is shown in Figure 5 .

For the head view, we retain the full token sequence to preserve spatial information about the broader scene [ 66 ] . We encode the language instruction with DistilBERT and mean-pool its output into a single embedding [ 67 ] . The visual tokens form the policy’s context sequence, while the language embedding conditions this sequence through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM) [ 68 ] . The visual backbones are initialized from pretraining and fine-tuned jointly with the policy, whereas the action generator is trained from scratch. Architecture and training details are provided in Appendix -J .

blocks.en: High-Level Agent Harness. The low-level policy provides closed-loop control for individual language-conditioned skills, but it is not designed to interpret open-ended requests, reason across multiple subtasks, or track progress over long horizons. We therefore place it within a VLM-based agent harness that separates task-level reasoning from physical execution. The harness operates in two phases: planning, which constructs a user-approved sequence of supported skills, and execution, which carries out this sequence while monitoring its progress. Separating these phases allows us to allocate more computation to planning and task-level reasoning before execution begins, enabling more reliable decomposition and management of long-horizon tasks, while favoring faster inference during execution monitoring in support of G3 . We instantiate the high-level agent using Gemini 3.5 Flash.
blocks.zh: 高级特工哈妮丝 低级政策为单个语言条件技能提供闭路控制,但并非旨在解释开放式请求,跨多个子任务的理由,或跟踪长期的进展. 因此,我们把它置于一个基于VLM的特工工具中,将任务层面的推理与实际执行区分开来。 该装置分两个阶段运作:规划,构建一个用户核准的辅助技能序列;执行,同时监测其进展。 分离这些阶段可以让我们在执行开始前将更多的计算分配到规划和任务层面的推理,从而能够更可靠地分解和管理长距离任务,同时在支持G3的执行监测过程中倾向于更快的推论. 我们用双子座3.5 Flash对高级特工进行即时攻击

blocks.en: During planning, the VLM receives the user request, the current head-camera observation, and, when replanning, the unfinished portion of the existing plan. It then constructs an ordered plan using a predefined skill library. Each skill is specified by a semantic description, a fixed instruction for the low-level policy, and visually verifiable success criteria. Restricting planning to this library grounds the VLM’s decisions in the capabilities represented in the policy’s training data and allows unsupported requests to be identified explicitly. The proposed plan is presented to the user for confirmation before execution begins.
blocks.zh: 在规划期间,VLM接收用户请求,即当前头摄像头观测,在重新规划时,接收现有计划未完成的部分. 然后它使用预定义的技能库构建一个命令式计划. 每种技能通过语义描述,低级政策的固定指令,以及可视化验证的成功标准来指定. 将规划限制在这个图书馆内,使虚拟LM的决定以政策培训数据所体现的能力为依据,并允许明确查明不支持的请求。 拟议计划将在开始执行前提交用户确认。

blocks.en: After confirmation, the harness executes the plan one skill at a time. For each step, it maps the selected skill to its fixed low-level instruction, invokes the policy, and maintains the state of the overall plan. The VLM monitors execution using the skill’s success criteria and a sparse visual history spanning the rollout. We construct this history from the observation at the start of the skill, a temporally intermediate keyframe selected to capture scene changes, a recent observation, and the latest camera image. This history serves as a compact visual memory, allowing the VLM to remember previous attempts, track meaningful progress, and determine whether the current skill has been completed while preserving fast inference. If progress repeatedly stalls or an unsafe condition is detected, the harness pauses execution and verbally requests assistance from the user. Users interact with the agent through speech and can confirm, pause, resume, stop, or revise the plan at any time. We use NVIDIA NeMo with the Parakeet Unified English 0.6B model for speech recognition and Piper for text-to-speech. Model configurations, prompts, and monitoring details are provided in Appendix -I .
blocks.zh: 经确认后,吊带一次一次执行一个技能的计划. 每一步,它都会将所选技能映射到其固定的低级指令,引用政策,保持总体计划状态. VLM使用技能成功标准以及横跨推出过程的稀少视觉历史来监控执行。 我们从技术开始的观察中构建这个历史, 一个时间上中间键框, 用来捕捉场景的变化, 最近的观察, 和最新的相机图像。 这个历史充当了紧凑的视觉记忆,使得VLM能够回忆之前的尝试,跟踪有意义的进展,并确定当前技能是否已经完成,同时保留快速推论. 如果反复发现进展停滞或不安全条件,便会暂停执行,并口头请求用户协助。 用户通过语音与代理人互动,可以随时确认,暂停,恢复,停止或修改计划. 我们使用NVIDIA NeMo与Parakeet统一英语0.6B模式进行语音识别,Piper用于文本对语音. 模型配置、提示和监测细节载于附录I。

blocks.en: Having described the design of Pixel, we next evaluate how effectively the complete system realizes design goals G1 – G3 . Specifically, our experiments address the following questions:
blocks.zh: 在描述了Pixel的设计之后,我们接下来评价整个系统如何有效地实现G1 — G3的设计目标。 我们的实验具体涉及以下问题:

blocks.en: 1. Do the co-designed hardware components provide the mechanical capability required for everyday manipulation? We evaluate how the robot’s different whole-body degrees of freedom contribute to its task performance, conduct analyses on its workspace, and further measure the gripper characteristics. 2. Do the control interfaces enable intuitive and compatible collection of human and robot demonstrations? We compare usability, collection efficiency, and ability to capture coordinated whole-body motion of different data collection methods. 3. Can we enable policies to learn reliable, long-horizon whole-body behaviors from demonstrations? We explore different policy design choices including observation and action spaces to understand their effects on policy performance.

blocks.en: 1. Toy Cleanup (103 demonstrations). Starting from a randomized pose with the coffee table in view, the robot must approach the table while lowering its body, pick up a randomly placed toy, strafe toward a nearby basket, and deposit the toy inside. This task evaluates whole-body coordination and generalization across objects and locations. 2. Tidy Pillow (129 demonstrations). Starting from a randomized location with the couch in view, the robot must navigate around obstacles such as a desk, coffee table, and toy basket before placing the couch pillows upright against the seat back. This task evaluates long-horizon navigation and bimanual manipulation. 3. Trash Disposal (189 demonstrations). The robot begins in front of a couch with a coffee cup placed on the seat. After picking up the cup, it must back away, actively scan the room to determine whether the trash can is to its left or right, navigate to it, and dispose of the cup. This task evaluates the ability to learn active vision from human demonstrations.

blocks.en: We evaluate whether the co-designed robot embodiment provides the mechanical capabilities required for complex mobile manipulation while remaining low cost and simple in construction. Our evaluation consists of three experiments. First, we ablate the lift, torso, and head degrees of freedom to assess their contributions to learned task performance and the retargeting of human demonstrations. Second, we evaluate the alignment between Pixel and the human body in terms of reachable workspace and compare its workspace with those of open-source and commercial mobile manipulators. Lastly, we compare our custom gripper with a purpose-built commercial robot gripper.
blocks.zh: 我们评价共同设计的机器人化身是否为复杂的移动操纵提供了所需的机械能力,同时保持低成本和建筑简单。 我们的评价包括三个实验。 首先,我们放弃升降机、躯干和头等自由度,以评估它们对学习任务业绩的贡献以及重新确定人类示威的目标。 其次,我们从可到达的工作空间的角度评价像素与人体的吻合性,并将其工作空间与开源和商业移动操纵器的工作空间进行比较. 最后,我们把自定义的握手 和专门制造的商业机器人握手相提并论

blocks.en: Robot Degree-of-Freedom Ablation. We evaluate the contributions of the lift, torso, and head on the Toy Cleanup, Tidy Pillow, and Trash Disposal tasks defined in Section IV-A . These tasks collectively require a broad range of mobile-manipulation capabilities.
blocks.zh: 机器人自由度障碍。 我们评价电梯、躯干、玩具清理、Tidy Pillow和垃圾处理任务的贡献。 这些任务集体需要广泛的移动操纵能力.

blocks.en: For each task, we train a single-task policy using the low-level policy architecture described in Section III-C . We then disable each of the lift, torso, and head degrees of freedom individually through the whole-body controller and evaluate the resulting autonomous policy. The same end-effector-based policy is used for all experiments. We conduct five trials for each experimental condition and report the task-progress scores.
blocks.zh: 对于每项任务,我们利用第三节C所述低级政策架构,培训一项单一任务政策。 然后,我们通过全身控制器 单独禁用每个升力、躯干和头部自由度 并评估由此产生的自主政策。 所有实验都采用同样的基于最终效果的政策。 我们针对每个实验条件进行五次试验,并报告任务进度分数。

blocks.en: Gripper Evaluation. We compare our custom gripper with a commercial AgileX Piper gripper based on a linear-rail and linkage mechanism. The evaluation measures closing force and grasp retention across eight objects of varying shapes and sizes.

blocks.en: We evaluate the four data-collection interfaces described in Section III-B : the Leader Arm system, VR Joystick, VR Body Tracking, and sensorized human data collection. Our evaluation examines the usability and collection efficiency of each interface.

blocks.en: User Study. We conduct a user study with 12 participants representing varying levels of prior teleoperation experience. Each participant performs the Tidy Pillow and Wine-Glass Pouring tasks defined in Section IV-A using all four interfaces.
blocks.zh: 用户研究. 我们与12名参与者进行了用户研究,他们代表了不同程度的以往远程业务经验。 每位参与者都使用所有四个接口执行第四节A部分界定的Tidy Pillow和Wine-Glass Pouling任务.

blocks.en: Before beginning the study, participants receive instructions for each interface and 5 minutes to familiarize themselves with its controls. We randomize the order of the tasks and interfaces to reduce biases arising from learning and presentation order. Each participant performs two attempts per task with each interface, yielding 16 attempts per participant. We record task-completion time and administer a short survey to assess participants’ preferences among the interfaces.
blocks.zh: 在开始研究前,参与者会收到每个接口的指令和5分钟熟悉其控制. 我们随机排列任务和接口的顺序,以减少学习和演示顺序所产生的偏见。 每个参与者在每个接口中进行两次尝试,每个参与者进行16次尝试。 我们记录任务完成时间,并进行一次简短的调查,以评估参与者在接口中的偏好。

blocks.en: Cross-Interface Data Compatibility. We additionally evaluate whether sensorized human demonstrations and robot-teleoperated demonstrations can be used jointly for policy training. For the Toy Cleanup and Tidy Pillow tasks, we compare single-task policies trained using only sensorized human demonstrations with policies co-trained using both sensorized human and robot-teleoperated demonstrations. Data is uniformly sampled from the two datasets to ensure balanced training.
blocks.zh: 跨界面数据兼容性. 我们进一步评估是否可以将感官化的人类示威和机器人-远程操作演示联合用于政策培训。 就玩具清理和Tidy Pillow任务而言,我们比较了只使用感知人类演示而训练的单任务政策与同时使用感知人类和机器人远程操作演示而训练的政策。 从两个数据集中统一抽取数据,以确保培训平衡。

blocks.en: We evaluate how observation and action representations affect mobile-manipulation policy performance. Our final policy uses all three RGB cameras and the relative-base action space described in Section III-C . We assess the importance of these choices through three sets of ablations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价观察和行动表现如何影响移动管理政策的业绩。 我们的最终政策是使用所有三台RGB相机和第三节C所述的相对基础行动空间。 我们通过三套办法评估这些选择的重要性。

blocks.en: Unless otherwise specified, for each task and ablation condition, we train a separate single-task policy and evaluate it over 20 rollouts spanning four randomized task configurations. We report task-progress scores for all experiments.

blocks.en: V-A Hardware Experimental Results
blocks.zh: V-A 硬件实验结果

blocks.en: Pixel’s set of degrees of freedom enables consistent performance across diverse mobile-manipulation tasks.
blocks.zh: Pixel的一套自由度可以使各种移动操纵任务具有一致的性能.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 10 , the complete system achieved 100 % 100\% task progress on all three evaluated tasks. Averaged across tasks, progress decreased to 47.4 % 47.4\% when the torso was disabled, 71.2 % 71.2\% when the lift was disabled, and 52.0 % 52.0\% when head control was disabled.
blocks.zh: 如图10所示,整个系统在所有三项评估任务上都取得了100%的100QQ任务进展。 平均而言,当躯干停用时,进展下降到47.4%,升降机停用时为71.2%,头部控制停用时为52.0%。

blocks.en: The importance of each degree of freedom depended on the task. For example, Toy Cleanup retained 100 % 100\% progress without head control, suggesting that the visual encoder can tolerate the fixed camera viewpoint for some simple tasks. In contrast, Tidy Pillow progress decreased to 14.3 % 14.3\% without torso motion and 20.0 % 20.0\% without head control. The torso extends the robot’s workspace when placing the pillow against the seat back, while active head control helps coordinate this whole-body motion. Trash Disposal progress similarly decreased to 36.0 % 36.0\% without head control. When collecting sensorized human demonstrations, humans naturally turn their heads to search for the trash can and keep it in view while approaching it. Disabling head control prevents the robot from realizing the head trajectories learned from this behavior, causing the camera viewpoint to diverge from the demonstrations and frequently preventing the robot from locating the trash can. Thus, although individual tasks may not require every degree of freedom, the complete embodiment enables consistent reproduction of the coordinated manipulation, navigation, and active-perception behaviors learned from sensorized human demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 每一程度的自由的重要性取决于任务。 例如,"玩具清理"(Toy Cleanup)保留了100%的"100QQ"没有头部控制的进展,暗示视觉编码器可以容忍一些简单任务的固定相机视角. 与此相反,Tidy Pillow的进步下降到14.3% 14.3% 没有躯干运动,20.0 % 没有头部控制。 躯干在把枕头放在座位背面时会延长机器人的工作空间,而主动头部控制则有助于协调这种全身运动. 同样,没有头部控制的垃圾处理进度也降至36.0% 36.0%。 在收集感官化的人类示威时,人类自然会转头寻找垃圾桶,并在接近垃圾桶时保持视线. 故障头部控制使得机器人无法意识到从这种行为中吸取的头部轨迹,导致镜头视角与演示不同,并经常阻止机器人定位垃圾桶. 因此,虽然个人任务可能并不要求任何程度的自由,但完全的体现使得协调操纵、导航和从感官化的人类演示中汲取的主动感知行为能够不断复制。

blocks.en: Pixel achieves the strongest alignment with the human workspace among the evaluated platforms. As shown in Table I , Pixel achieves the highest Overall Reach Match at 90.99 % 90.99\% , while covering 89.89 % 89.89\% of the human workspace with a Relative Workspace Volume of 1.11 1.11 .

Among platforms without articulated lower bodies, Pixel achieves the highest Overall Reach Match and Human Reach Coverage. YOR provides the closest comparison, achieving an Overall Reach Match of 89.80 % 89.80\% and the highest Arm-Specific Reach Match at 84.27 % 84.27\% . However, YOR covers a smaller fraction of the human workspace ( 79.65 % 79.65\% ), while AGIBOT-G1 and Mobile ALOHA achieve lower Overall Reach Matches of 75.22 % 75.22\% and 66.50 % 66.50\% , respectively. These results suggest that Pixel’s combination of torso articulation and vertical lift provides broad human-aligned reach without requiring an articulated lower body.
blocks.zh: 在没有清晰的下层机构的平台中,像素实现了最高的"整体达标"和"人类达标". YOR提供了最接近的比较,实现了89.80%89.80%的总射程比对和84.27%84.27%的最高射程比对. 然而,YOR覆盖了人类工作空间的一小部分(79.65% 79.65%%),而AGIBOT-G1和Mobile ALOHA分别实现了75.22%的75.22%和66.50%的66.50%的低总射程匹配. 这些结果表明,Pixel将躯干伸缩和垂直升力结合起来,可以提供广泛的人与人相配合的接触,而不需要一个清晰的下体。

blocks.en: Platforms with articulated lower bodies exhibit a different tradeoff. RB-Y1M and Dexmate both achieve 100 % 100\% Human Reach Coverage, but their workspaces are 3.02 × 3.02\times and 4.37 × 4.37\times the human workspace volume and produce substantially lower Overall Reach Matches of 54.65 % 54.65\% and 41.28 % 41.28\% , respectively. Although their additional lower-body degrees of freedom expand fixed-base reach, much of the resulting workspace lies outside the human workspace. In contrast, Pixel provides a closer balance between coverage, workspace size, and spatial correspondence with human reach.
blocks.zh: 下体清晰的平台有不同的取舍。 RB-Y1M和Dexmate都实现了100%的百分百人覆盖率,但他们的工作空间分别为3.02×3.02\时和4.37×4.37\时,人类工作空间的体积,生产的总覆盖率分别低得多,分别为54.65%和41.28%。 虽然他们额外的下体自由度扩展了固定基数范围,但由此产生的工作空间大多位于人类工作空间之外. 相比之下,像素在覆盖度,工作空间大小,和与人类接触的空间通信之间提供了更紧密的平衡.

blocks.en: Because the base remains stationary in this analysis, these results isolate each platform’s local manipulation workspace. During mobile manipulation, base repositioning can recover many otherwise unreachable positions. The coverage advantage provided by an articulated lower body may therefore be smaller when the full mobility of the platform is considered.
blocks.zh: 由于这一分析的基础保持不变,这些结果孤立了每个平台的本地操纵工作空间。 在移动操纵期间,基地重新定位可以恢复许多原本无法到达的位置. 因此,在考虑平台的充分流动性时,下层机构提供的覆盖优势可能较小。

blocks.zh: 表格 一:人-机器人工作空间比较. Reach-match的分数使用50mm 50\,\mathrm{mm} 容量;覆盖和相对量使用最初的25mm 25\,\mathrm{mm} voxel 占用.

blocks.en: Pixel’s low-cost gripper outperforms the commercial AgileX Piper gripper in grasp retention and closing force. Our gripper resisted 82.7 ± 2.6 ​ N 82.7\pm 2.6\,\mathrm{N} during horizontal pull-out tests, compared with 46.4 ± 3.4 ​ N 46.4\pm 3.4\,\mathrm{N} for the AgileX Piper gripper, an improvement of 78 % 78\% . During vertical pull-out tests, it resisted 71.0 ± 3.0 ​ N 71.0\pm 3.0\,\mathrm{N} , compared with 43.4 ± 6.1 ​ N 43.4\pm 6.1\,\mathrm{N} , an improvement of 63 % 63\% . Its measured closing force was 92.9 ± 2.4 ​ N 92.9\pm 2.4\,\mathrm{N} , compared with 63.3 ± 1.5 ​ N 63.3\pm 1.5\,\mathrm{N} , an improvement of 47 % 47\% . Thus, across the three tests, our gripper produced 1.47 × 1.47\times – 1.78 × 1.78\times the force of the commercial comparison gripper despite using the same motor for actuation.
blocks.zh: Pixel低价的握手比商业的AgileX Piper握手要好, 我们的抓手在横向拉出试验中抵抗了82.7±2.6 N 82.7\pm 2.6\,\mathrm{N},而AgileX Piper 抓手则抵抗了46.4±3.4 N 46.4\pm 3.4\,\mathrm{N},改进率为78% 78%。 在垂直拉出试验中,它抵抗 71.0 ± 3.0 N 71.0\pm 3.0\,\mathrm{N},与43.4 ± 6.1 N 43.4\pm 6.1\,\mathrm{N}相比,改进了63% 63\X. 其测量的关闭力为92.9±2.4 N 92.9\pm 2.4\,\mathrm{N},而63.3± 1.5 N 63.3\pm 1.5\,\mathrm{N}的改进率为47% 47% 。 因此,在三次测试中,我们的抓手生产了1.47×1.47\时 — 1.78×1.78\时,尽管使用同一马达进行触发,但商业比较抓手的威力却很大。

blocks.en: Moreover, our gripper reached the 100 ​ N 100\,\mathrm{N} experimental safety limit in half of the pull-out trials, meaning that the object could not be removed before reaching the measurement cap. Because these measurements are capped, the reported pull-out forces conservatively underestimate the gripper’s actual retention force in these trials. We attribute this performance to the combination of the compliant membrane, silicone contact surfaces, and rigid supporting structure, which allows the gripper to conform to objects while maintaining a strong grasp.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的抓手在拉出试验的一半中达到了100 N 100\,\mathrm{N}的实验安全极限,这意味着在达到测量上限之前无法移除物体. 由于这些测量被封顶,据报道的退出力量保守地低估了这些试验中抓手的实际保留力. 我们把这种性能归结于遵守膜,硅酮接触表面,和刚性支撑结构的结合,这让抓子在保持强把握的同时,能够与物体相配合.

blocks.en: Fig. 10: (a) We find that torso, lift, and head motion jointly support consistent task success across the evaluated tasks. (b) Pixel’s gripper outperforms commercial alternatives such as the AgileX Piper gripper in grasping force and stability.
blocks.zh: 图10:(a) 我们发现,躯干、起重和头部运动共同支持在各项评估任务中始终如一地取得成功。 (b) Pixel的握手比AgileX Piper握手等商业替代品更能抓住力和稳定性。

blocks.en: Fig. 11: (a) User preferences obtained through a survey on different data collection methods. (b) Mean completion times for two user-study tasks using different data collection interfaces. (c) Our shared interface and controller design enables co-training to improve performance.
blocks.zh: 图11:(a) 通过调查不同数据收集方法获得的用户偏好。 (b) 使用不同数据收集接口的两个用户学习任务的平均完成时间。 (c) 我们的共享接口和控制器设计使共同培训能够提高性能。

blocks.en: V-B Data Collection Interface Experimental Results
blocks.zh: V-B 数据收集接口实验结果

blocks.en: VR Joystick provides the strongest all-around teleoperation interface, while sensorized human data collection is unanimously preferred and substantially faster than teleoperation.
blocks.zh: VR Joystick提供了最强的全方位远程操作接口,而感官化的人类数据收集则被一致偏爱,并且大大快于远程操作.

blocks.en: Comparing teleoperation approaches. As shown in Figure 11 , participants preferred VR Joystick among the three teleoperation interfaces. It was most frequently ranked as the best teleoperation option, while Leader Arm occupied an intermediate position with a more balanced spread across rankings. VR Body Tracking ranked lowest, with most participants listing it as their least-preferred interface.
blocks.zh: 比较电信业务方法。 如图11所示,与会者倾向于在三个远程操作界面中采用VR Joystick。 它最常被评为最佳远程运营选项,而"头盔"则占据中间位置,各排名分布较为均衡. VR机身跟踪排名最低,大多数参与者将其列为最不受欢迎的界面.

blocks.en: This preference ranking was partially reflected in mean task-completion time. Leader Arm was slightly faster than VR Joystick on Tidy Pillow ( 35.3 ​ s 35.3\,\mathrm{s} versus 39.0 ​ s 39.0\,\mathrm{s} ), whereas VR Joystick was faster on Wine-Glass Pouring ( 29.1 ​ s 29.1\,\mathrm{s} versus 36.9 ​ s 36.9\,\mathrm{s} ). VR Body Tracking had the longest mean completion time on Tidy Pillow, for which accurate base positioning was particularly important. Although Leader Arm did not provide a consistent completion-time advantage under the evaluated conditions, neither task was designed to isolate the benefits of physical grounding or force feedback. We hypothesize that Leader Arm may provide a larger advantage in contact-rich tasks requiring sustained contact and accurate force application, such as operating stiff handles, opening doors, or performing constrained insertion.
blocks.zh: 这种优先排序部分反映在平均任务完成时间中。 头盔在Tidy Pillow(35.3 s 35.3\,\mathrm{s}对39.0 s 39.0\,\mathrm{s})上比VR Joystick稍快,而在Wine-Glass Pouring(29.1 s 29.1\,\mathrm{s}对36.9 s 36.9\,\mathrm{s}上则比VR Joystick更快. VR 机体 Tidy Pillow的跟踪平均完成时间最长,准确的基地定位对此特别重要。 虽然Arm领队在评估条件下没有提供一致的完成时间优势,但无论是设计任务都未能隔离实际搁浅或武力反馈的好处. 我们假设Arm领队在需要持续接触和精确施用武力的富于接触的任务中可能具有更大的优势,例如操作僵硬的手柄,打开门,或进行受限制的插入。

blocks.en: Participants’ qualitative feedback provides a possible explanation for these results. Users preferred the explicit joystick-based control of the mobile base available in VR Joystick and Leader Arm over mapping their body motion to the robot base through the whole-body controller. They reported that the joystick enabled more precise base placement, which may explain why VR Body Tracking was both less preferred and slower on Tidy Pillow, a task requiring substantial base movement.
blocks.zh: 与会者的质量反馈为这些结果提供了可能的解释。 用户更倾向于对VR Joystick和Leader Arm中可用的移动基座进行明确的基于乐杆的控制,而不是通过全身控制器将身体运动映射到机器人基座. 他们报告说,乐杆使基座布置更加精确,这可以解释为什么VR机身跟踪在Tidy Pillow上更不可取,也更慢,这项任务需要大量的基座运动.

blocks.en: These results suggest that VR Joystick provides the strongest overall balance of user preference and completion time among the evaluated teleoperation interfaces, supporting its use as the default interface for Pixel.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,VR Joystick在被评价的远程操作界面中提供了用户偏好和完成时间的最强总体平衡,支持将其用作像素的默认接口.

blocks.en: Sensorized human data vs. teleoperation. As shown in Figure 11 , every participant ranked Sensorized Human first for both tasks. This preference was reflected in task-completion time. Sensorized Human required only 8.4 ± 1.7 ​ s 8.4\pm 1.7\,\mathrm{s} for Tidy Pillow and 6.7 ± 1.9 ​ s 6.7\pm 1.9\,\mathrm{s} for Wine-Glass Pouring. By comparison, the three teleoperation interfaces required 35.3 35.3 – 52.1 ​ s 52.1\,\mathrm{s} and 29.1 29.1 – 36.9 ​ s 36.9\,\mathrm{s} for the two tasks, respectively. Sensorized Human therefore achieved a 4.2 × 4.2\times – 6.2 × 6.2\times speedup over teleoperation across the interface–task comparisons. Completion times were also substantially less variable, with standard deviations of only 1.7 1.7 – 1.9 ​ s 1.9\,\mathrm{s} compared with 8.5 8.5 – 20.8 ​ s 20.8\,\mathrm{s} for teleoperation, indicating more consistent performance across participants with varying levels of prior experience.
blocks.zh: 感应人类数据与远程操作. 如图11所示,每个参与者在两项任务中都将感知人类排在首位。 这种倾向体现在任务完成时间上。 感应人类只需要8.4±1.7 s 8.4\pm 1.7\pm,\mathrm{s}对Tidy Pillow和6.7±1.9 s 6.7\pm 1.9\pm,\mathrm{s}对葡萄酒-玻璃弹丸. 相比之下,三个远程操作接口分别需要35.3 35.3 – 52.1 s 52.1\,\mathrm{s} 和29.1 29.1 – 36.9 s 36.9\,\mathrm{s}完成这两项任务. 因此感应人类实现了4.2×4.2\时 – 6.2×6.2\时 跨界面的远程操作加速 –任务比较. 完成时间的可变性也大为降低,标准偏差仅为1.7 1.7 – 1.9 s 1.9\,\mathrm{s}与8.5 – 20.8 s 20.8\,\mathrm{s}的远程运营相比,只有8.5 – 20.8 s 20.8\,\mathrm{s}的偏差,表明以往经验水平不同的参与者的表现更加一致.

blocks.en: Participants’ qualitative feedback offered a possible explanation for these results. Sensorized Human required little acclimation because users could perform the tasks directly using their own whole-body motion rather than translating their intent through an intermediate robot-control interface. Its preference, speed, and consistency advantages held across both the whole-body Tidy Pillow task and the dexterous Wine-Glass Pouring task, supporting direct, embodiment-aligned human demonstrations as an efficient approach to scalable mobile-manipulation data collection.
blocks.zh: 与会者的质量反馈对这些结果提供了可能的解释。 感应人类不需要多少适应,因为用户可以直接使用自己的全身运动来完成这些任务,而不是通过中间机器人控制接口来翻译他们的意图. 它的偏好、速度和一致性优势贯穿于全身的Tidy Pillow任务和脱节的Wine-Glass Pouring任务,支持直接的、表现相协调的人类示范,作为可扩展的移动操纵数据收集的有效方法。

blocks.en: Fig. 12: (a) Comparison of observation- and action-space design choices for policy training with sensorized human data . (b) Comparison of observation- and action-space design choices for policy training with robot teleoperation data .
blocks.zh: 图12:(a) 将观测和行动空间设计选择与人类感知数据进行政策培训进行比较。 (b) 将观测和行动空间政策培训设计选择与机器人远程操作数据进行比较。

blocks.en: Human–robot alignment enables joint training on sensorized human and robot-teleoperated demonstrations. Figure 11 further shows that balanced co-training increased average task progress from 85.0 % 85.0\% using sensorized human data alone to 94.3 % 94.3\% across Toy Cleanup and Tidy Pillow. This improvement was driven by Toy Cleanup, where progress increased from 75.0 % 75.0\% to 95.0 % 95.0\% . On Tidy Pillow, performance remained comparable, changing from 95.0 % 95.0\% to 93.6 % 93.6\% . These results suggest that the shared observation and action spaces, together with the whole-body controller, place sensorized human and teleoperated demonstrations in a compatible representation space, allowing the system to combine efficiently collected human behavior with robot-specific data to improve policy performance.
blocks.zh: 人-机器人对接使得能够就感官化的人类和机器人-远程操作演示进行联合培训。 图11进一步显示,在整个玩具清理和Tidy Pillow,平衡的联合培训平均任务进度从仅使用感知人类数据的85.0%85.0%提高到94.3 %。 这一改进是由玩具清理(Toy cleanup)推动的,其进展从75.0% 75.0\%提高到95.0% 95.0\%. 在Tidy Pillow上,性能依然相当,从95.0% 95.0\%变为93.6% 93.6\%. 这些结果表明,共享的观测和行动空间与全身控制器一起,将感知到的人类和远程操作的演示置于兼容的表示空间,使系统能够将高效收集的人类行为与机器人特定数据结合起来,以提高政策性能.

blocks.en: V-C Policy Design Experimental Results
blocks.zh: V-C 政策设计实验结果

blocks.en: Complementary head and wrist views enable both fine-grained manipulation and active perception. As shown in Figure 12 , using all three cameras produced the highest average task progress for both data sources. For policies trained with sensorized human demonstrations, the complete observation space achieved 82.0 % 82.0\% average progress, compared with 66.5 % 66.5\% using only the wrist cameras and 39.9 % 39.9\% using only the head camera. The same trend held for robot-teleoperated data, for which the complete observation space achieved 78.7 % 78.7\% average progress, compared with 74.0 % 74.0\% and 59.5 % 59.5\% for the wrist-only and head-only configurations, respectively.
blocks.zh: 补充头部和腕部的视线既能进行精细的操纵,又能积极感知。 如图12所示,使用所有三台相机为这两个数据来源的平均任务进度最高。 在经过感官人类演示培训的政策中,整个观测空间的平均进展率为82.0%,而仅使用腕相机的观测率为66.5%,仅使用头相机的观测率为39.9%。 机器人远程操作数据趋势相同,完整的观测空间平均进展率为78.7%,而手腕和头部配置分别是74.0%、74.0%和59.5%。

blocks.en: The individual tasks illustrate why both perspectives are needed. Head-only policies achieved just 5.0 % 5.0\% progress on Toy Cleanup and 0 % 0\% on Vacuum Cleaning, consistent with the loss of close-range visual information needed to align grasps and interact with small controls such as the vacuum power button. Removing the head camera also prevents the policy from reliably reproducing active-perception behaviors present in the sensorized human demonstrations. During Trash Disposal, human demonstrators naturally turn their heads while backing away from the couch to search for and locate the trash can. Although the corresponding head motion remains part of the predicted action, a wrist-only policy does not observe the head-camera images that give this behavior its visual context. During Hang Jacket, the garment can cover both wrist cameras as it is transferred from the person to the robot. A wrist-only policy can therefore become completely visually occluded at a critical point in the task, whereas the head camera retains a view of the person, garment, and surrounding scene. Thus, the complete observation space is not necessary for every individual task, but it provides the most consistent performance across behaviors requiring close-range manipulation, active visual search, and robustness to camera occlusion.
blocks.zh: 个别任务说明为什么需要这两种观点。 仅头部政策在玩具清理上只取得了5.0%的5.0%的进度,在真空清理上只取得了0 %的进度,这与失去近距离视觉信息以配合抓取和与真空电源按钮等小控件相互作用是相一致的. 移除头摄像头也使政策无法可靠地复制感知人类演示中存在的主动感知行为. 在垃圾处理期间, 人类示威者自然会转头, 尽管相应的头动仍然是预言动作的一部分,但只用手腕的策略并不观察到头-相机图像给出这种行为的视觉上下文. 在Hang Jacket期间,服装可以覆盖两个手腕相机,因为它从人转移到机器人. 因此,只戴手腕的政策可以在任务的关键时刻完全视而不见,而头部摄像机则保留了人物、服装和周围场景的视野。 因此,完整的观测空间并不是每个单个任务都必需的,而是提供最一致的跨行为表现,需要近距离操纵,主动的视觉搜索,以及强力的摄像头闭塞.

blocks.en: A shared, ground-anchored action frame improves long-horizon coordination while remaining compatible with both human and robot data. On the sensorized-human tasks, our relative-base action space achieved 82.0 % 82.0\% average task progress, outperforming relative-pure at 67.3 % 67.3\% and relative-head at 25.7 % 25.7\% . The difference was most pronounced on Tidy Pillow, where relative-base achieved 95.0 % 95.0\% progress, compared with 47.9 % 47.9\% for relative-pure and 25.0 % 25.0\% for relative-head. Relative-pure remained effective on shorter or less tightly coordinated tasks, reaching 85.0 % 85.0\% on Toy Cleanup and 69.0 % 69.0\% on Trash Disposal. However, because the head and two end effectors are independently referenced at the beginning of each action chunk, we observed drift and loss of bimanual coordination during longer-horizon behaviors. Relative-head provides a shared reference frame, but it couples the gripper trajectories to errors in the predicted head pose. We observed that vertical head-pose drift consequently propagated to both end effectors and frequently caused task failure. In contrast, relative-base expresses all three trajectories in a common chunk-start frame while preserving ground-anchored height and orientation, preventing head-prediction errors from redefining the gripper reference frame.
blocks.zh: 一个共同的地面定位行动框架可以改善长距离协调,同时与人类和机器人数据保持兼容。 在感官-人类任务方面,我们的相对行动空间取得了82.0%的82.0%的平均任务进度,超过67.3%的相对纯度和25.7%的相对头部。 这一差别在Tidy Pillow上最为明显,相对基数取得了95.0%的95.0%的进步,而相对纯度为47.9%,相对头数为25.0%。 相对纯度在较短或不太紧密协调的任务上依然有效,在玩具清理方面达到85.0%85.0%,在垃圾处理方面达到69.0%69.0%。 然而,由于头部和两个端效应器在每块动作开始时都独立引用,我们观察到在较长距离的行为中漂移和失去双人协调. 相对头提供了共享的参考框架,但它将夹角轨迹与预测头部姿势的错误相配. 我们看到,垂直头部漂移会传播到两个端效应器,并经常造成任务失败。 相比之下,相对基则在共同块启动框架中表达所有三个轨迹,同时保留地心悬浮高度和方向,防止头部预测错误重新定义抓取参考框架.

blocks.en: On the robot-teleoperation tasks, absolute joint-space actions achieved 86.3 % 86.3\% average progress, compared with 78.7 % 78.7\% for relative-base end-effector actions. We therefore do not conclude that end-effector actions are intrinsically superior to joint-space control. Rather, we choose relative-base as it retains strong robot performance while providing a representation that is directly available from both sensorized human and robot-teleoperated demonstrations.
blocks.zh: 在机器人-远程操作任务上,绝对联合空间动作实现了86.3%的86.3\%平均进度,而相对基端效应动作则达到了78.7%的78.7\%. 因此,我们不认为最终效应行动在本质上优于联合空间控制。 相反,我们选择相对基础,因为它保留了强大的机器人性能,同时提供一种直接从感官化的人类和机器人远程操作演示中获得的表示.

blocks.en: VI CONCLUSION & LIMITATIONS
blocks.zh: 六、结论和限制

blocks.en: We presented Pixel, an open-source, co-designed wheeled humanoid and integrated robot-learning stack spanning hardware, whole-body control, data collection, and policy learning. Rather than developing these layers in isolation, Pixel co-designs them around a central goal of enabling broad autonomous mobile manipulation. Our evaluations show that this full-stack approach supports dexterous, long-horizon mobile manipulation while keeping the system low-cost, reproducible, and safe to operate in human environments.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了Pixel, 一个开源的, 共同设计的轮式人造物 和机器人综合学习堆栈 跨越硬件, 全身控制, 数据收集, 和政策学习。 Pixel与其孤立地开发这些层,不如围绕一个中心目标共同设计它们,以促成广泛的自主移动操纵. 我们的评价表明,这种全层式方法支持灵活、长视距的移动操纵,同时保持系统的低成本、可复制性和安全性,以便在人类环境中运作。

blocks.en: Several limitations point to important directions for future work. First, Pixel’s wheeled, low-cost embodiment trades some mobility and dexterity for simplicity and safety: it cannot traverse stairs or match the range of motion and manipulation capabilities of a full humanoid with dexterous hands. Future work should systematically characterize these tradeoffs and explore how improved affordable actuators and mechanisms can expand capability without compromising reproducibility or safety. Second, the sensorized human interface records head and gripper trajectories but does not capture uninstrumented body motions or contacts, such as bracing a door with an elbow, and lacks tactile sensing. Richer full-body tracking, action estimation, and multimodal sensing could preserve more of the expressivity of human demonstrations. Finally, the high-level agent’s ability to compose learned skills has not been systematically evaluated. Because it operates over a predefined skill library, it cannot execute unsupported skills and offers limited compositional generalization. Expanding this repertoire, improving hierarchical policy architectures, and evaluating them on longer-horizon tasks remain important directions.
blocks.zh: 有几个局限性指出了未来工作的重要方向。 首先,Pixel的轮式、低成本的化身为简洁和安全而交换了一定的机动性和弹性:它不能穿过楼梯,也不能与全人类的动作和操纵能力相匹配。 今后的工作应系统地确定这些权衡的特征,并探讨如何在不损害可复制性或安全性的情况下,改进负担得起的推动者和机制扩大能力。 其次,感官化的人类界面记录头部和握手轨迹,但不能捕捉无仪表的身体运动或接触,如用肘子压门,缺乏触觉感知. 更丰富的全体跟踪、动作估计和多式联运可以更多地保持人类演示的表现形式。 最后,尚未系统地评估高级代理商对所学技能的构成能力。 由于它运行在一个预定义的技能库上,所以它不能执行不支持的技能,并且提供有限的组成概括. 扩大这一轮廓,改进分级政策结构,并评估其长期任务,仍然是重要方向。

blocks.en: Ultimately, Pixel provides an open foundation for advancing hardware, data, and learning together.
blocks.zh: 最终,像素为推进硬件,数据和共同学习提供了开放的基础.
